enableCheckpointing.description:
If true, then the job will save checkpoints between successive {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Processor#components}
within the job's #processor as well as between both the #processor and the #embedder and the #embedder and the #vectorStore.

processor.description: The processor that will be used to process the input files to produce output entries that can be embedded.

embedder.description:
If provided, the output entries of #processor will be embedded using this embedder.
If not provided, then #enableCheckpointing must be true so that the output entries of #processor are saved.

vectorStore.description:
If provided, the output entries of #embedder will be stored as {@link GenaiCore.Vector}s in this vector store.
**NOTE** This is only applicable if #embedder is provided.
If not provided, then #enableCheckpointing must be true so that the output entries of #processor or #embedder are saved.

actionRequirement.description:
The action requirement needed for the job to run. If unspecified, then the action requirement of the {@link #processor}
will be used.
NOTE: from the job's perspective, the processor (and all of its components) and the embedder run in the same process, with
the same runtime. The individual components can remote to other processes or make calls to LLM providers within their own
implementations.

nodePool.description:
The name of the node pool to use for running the job.
NOTE: from the job's perspective, the processor (and all of its components) and the embedder run in the same process, on
the same node in the node pool. The individual components can remote to other processes or make calls to LLM providers
within their own implementations. For example, if a component needs specialized hardware that is not desired to be shared
among other components, then it is suggested to deploy the primary logic for that component as an {@link Engine} and have the
component simply make a call to the engine.

checkpointSerializer.description: The serializer to use for saving and loading checkpoints.

batchSize.description: The number of items to process in each batch when embedding processor output.

upsertBatchSize.description: The number of items to process in each batch when upserting embeddings output to vector store.

disableJobRunCleanUp.description:
If set to true, then the `unstructured-job-run-cleanup` {@link CronJob} will not affect runs from this job.
See {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job#cleanupJobRuns} for usage.

timeToLiveMinutes.description:
The number of minutes that a {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.Run} and {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.SourceRun} are
stored in the database before they are automatically cleaned up by the `unstructured-job-run-cleanup` {@link CronJob}.
See {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job#cleanupJobRuns} for usage.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

title:
A job that processes unstructured data. By default, the job will proceed by
   1. Passing all files within {@link #start}'s `sourceDir` to #processor
   2. Passing the output of #processor to #embedder
   3. Passing the output of #embedder to #vectorStore

If #enableCheckpointing is true, the job will save checkpoints at each stage of processing.
name: GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job
